source.author: Go course authors (drafted by an AI model)

review.notes: Machine-drafted by an AI model; awaiting review by a Latinist. House style: simple Church Latin, spelled without macrons, with u/v and i/j as in Stage 0 (v and i only); present tense, with a few perfects (venit, vidit, fuit, dixit) in the last units.

sentences.text: Hodie Samuel in foro est. Martha quoque in foro est.
sentences.english: Today Samuel is in the market. Martha is in the market too.

sentences.text: Martha panem vendit. Martha lac vendit. Martha vinum quoque vendit.
sentences.english: Martha sells bread. Martha sells milk. Martha sells wine too.

sentences.text: Salve, Martha! Quomodo vales?
sentences.english: Hello, Martha! How are you?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Bene valeo. Et tu? Quomodo vales?
sentences.english: I am well. And you? How are you?
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Bene valeo, sed fessus sum.
sentences.english: I am well, but I am tired.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Ecce panis! Panis bonus est. Panemne vis?
sentences.english: Look, bread! The bread is good. Do you want bread?
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Panem volo. Quid est hoc? Estne vinum?
sentences.english: I want bread. What is this? Is it wine?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Non est vinum. Lac est. Lac bonum est. Lacne vis?
sentences.english: It is not wine. It is milk. The milk is good. Do you want milk?
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Lac volo, sed vinum non volo.
sentences.english: I want milk, but I do not want wine.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Bene! Ecce panis, ecce lac. Panem et lac tibi do.
sentences.english: Good! Look, bread, look, milk. I give you bread and milk.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Gratias tibi ago, Martha. Panem et lac emo. Quid do?
sentences.english: Thank you, Martha. I am buying bread and milk. What do I give?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Hodie panem tibi do, sed cras panem emis. Panem tibi vendo.
sentences.english: Today I give you bread, but tomorrow you buy bread. I sell you bread.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Bene! Cras panem emo, et lac emo.
sentences.english: Good! Tomorrow I buy bread, and I buy milk.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Anna quoque in foro est.
sentences.english: Anna is in the market too.

sentences.text: Salve, Martha! Salve, Samuel! Quomodo valetis?
sentences.english: Hello, Martha! Hello, Samuel! How are you?
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Bene valemus, Anna. Samuel panem emit. Ecce panis!
sentences.english: We are well, Anna. Samuel is buying bread. Look, bread!
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Ego quoque panem volo. Panis bonus est.
sentences.english: I want bread too. The bread is good.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Panem tibi do, Anna. Cras panem emis.
sentences.english: I give you bread, Anna. Tomorrow you buy bread.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Gratias tibi ago, Martha. Et ubi est Marcus? Estne in schola?
sentences.english: Thank you, Martha. And where is Marcus? Is he at school?
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Marcus in schola est. Puer bonus est.
sentences.english: Marcus is at school. He is a good boy.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Et Lucius? Magister quoque in schola est?
sentences.english: And Lucius? Is the teacher at school too?
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Lucius magister est. Hodie in schola est, et cras in schola est.
sentences.english: Lucius is a teacher. Today he is at school, and tomorrow he is at school.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Bene! Vale, Martha! Vale, Samuel!
sentences.english: Good! Goodbye, Martha! Goodbye, Samuel!
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Pax tibi, Anna. Pax tibi, Samuel. Cras ad forum venitis!
sentences.english: Peace to you, Anna. Peace to you, Samuel. Tomorrow you come to the market!
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Cras ad forum eo. Panem et lac emo. Gratias tibi ago!
sentences.english: Tomorrow I go to the market. I buy bread and milk. Thank you!
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Hodie dies bonus est. Samuel panem et lac habet. Bene est.
sentences.english: Today is a good day. Samuel has bread and milk. It is well.
